integrity: Proof is by exact polynomial identities, an elementary discriminant factorization, and induction. The verifier checks identities and the sharp boundary example but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only the explicit recurrent four-cycle and proves universality only for \(c\ne4\). It does not classify the \(c=4\) lifting locus or other coefficient cycles.
title: Universal lifting on the recurrent nonunit four-cycle outside the unique exceptional parameter
